messages:
sarah: Drafting the internal RN snippet for today's micro-release. Need quick ops pin and a final confirm on rollback lanes. Suggest start 16:00 PST, canary 10% for 20m. Rollback criteria: error rate spike >0.5% OR p50 latency regression >100ms. Rollback target: tag v3.2.0. Snippet below — please keep messaging tight and non‑promissory.

sarah: ```
What changed: batching and KV-cache heuristics improved for text-generation paths. Typical workloads see lower token cost and higher throughput.
Impact: ~10–15% cost reduction in our internal benchmarks; no API contract changes.
Operational notes: pinned to model rwd-gen-2026-03b; canary rollout; automatic fallback to rwd-gen-2026-03a if errors or latency regressions detected.
Rollback triggers: error rate >0.5% or p50 latency +100ms.
```

kevin: +1 to the tech content. Suggest wording tweak: replace exact % wording with "typical workloads" to avoid committing a number in public-facing RN. Also add a one-line 'who to contact' ops oncall.

emily: agree with kevin. For ops: canary 10% for 20m, then 50% for 10m, then full if green. Will add that to the runbook.

mike: oncall here — I'll monitor. I'll run the smoke suite and watch p50/p95 + error rate. @deploy-bot please queue the deploy when we lock the start time. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled a deploy request placeholder. To execute run:
```
/deploy rwd-gen-2026-03b --canary=10 --canary-duration=20m --staged=50:10m --owner=@mike --pin=true
```
Note: this is a draft command, requires an approver before execution.

ops-bot: Linking runbooks and playbooks: <https://internal.runbooks/release/rwd-gen-2026-03b> (add final checks). Also tagging incident playbook v2.0 for rollback steps.

jane: heads-up — there's a DB maintenance at 16:15 PST in infra that might overlap. recommend moving start to 17:00 PST to avoid chase.

sarah: good catch @jane. Let's move to 17:00 PST. @deploy-bot update schedule accordingly and keep canary windows the same.

deploy-bot: Updated schedule: start=6345133200 (17:00 PST), canary=10/20m, staged=50/10m. Awaiting approval to execute.

mike: I'll be on standby from 16:45–18:15. Setting metric alerts: p50 >100ms and error rate >0.5% to page oncall.

emily: I'll add a short note for Dedicated customers: "No changes to reserved capacity or SLAs; improvements are inference-side only."

kevin: Draft internal blurb for staff digest (2 lines):
"We deployed improvements to the text-generation serving stack (batching + KV-cache heuristics), reducing token cost in typical workloads and increasing throughput. Ops: canary rollout at 17:00 PST, rollback plan in runbook; oncall monitoring active. Contact @mike for immediate ops issues."

sarah: perfect. I'll pin this thread and copy the final RN into #staff-digest at 16:30 for review. Please react with :thumbsup: if you approve the final wording and timing.

kevin: :thumbsup:

emily: :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:

jane: :thumbsup:

sarah: Thanks team — locking 17:00 PST. I'll post the short RN draft to staff and drop the runbook link. If anything changes, update this thread immediately.

kevin: Final RN snippet saved to draft: <https://docs.internal/releases/rwd-gen-2026-03b-draft> (ready to paste).

emily: I'll follow up with a one-line note for Customer Success for Dedicated accounts.

mike: Monitoring hooks in place, will call rollback if thresholds hit.

sarah: (closing) moving to deploy prep.
